# Ryujinx shader translator (vendored subset)

Three projects from Ryujinx 1.3.2: `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader`, `Ryujinx.Common` and `Spv.Generator`, with these local changes:

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/CodeGen/Spirv/Instructions.cs`, `GenerateTextureSample`:
  - Texel offsets that are not constants (Maxwell AOFFI / TLD4.PTP offsets read from a register) are built with `OpCompositeConstruct` and passed as `Offset`. A four-offset gather becomes four one-offset gathers, each giving component w. Upstream wrote them as an `OpConstantComposite` with `ConstOffset(s)`, which is invalid SPIR-V; SPIRV-Cross threw `nullptr` and the shader never built (2026-10-18: 8 shaders in Wonder, Link's Awakening, Tears of the Kingdom and Age of Calamity). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.
  - Texture coordinates that are NaN are replaced by 0 (the `nfZero` select). This came with the first import.
- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/Optimizations/BindlessElimination.cs`, `TryGetOperation` / `IsSameOperand`: a bindless handle that reaches the texture instruction through a phi is followed through the phis that feed it (a handle kept in a loop variable comes back through the loop's own phi), and two `constant buffer | constant` handles count as the same value. Upstream compared only the phi's direct inputs, so such handles fell to the texture-pool array of 32 (`*_t2d_cb0_40000000`), which cannot be bound; 218 pixel shaders in Monster Hunter Rise (2026-10-20). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.
- The same file, `TryTableHandle` and `IsBindlessHandleAllowed`, with `Translation/Optimizations/Optimizer.cs` (a second sweep) and `Translation/ResourceManager.cs` (`GetTextureTypes`): a handle phi that `GenerateBindlessAccess` refuses, because some inputs are not handles (undefined, or values kept in the same register on paths where the predicated read does not run), takes the c2 handles among its inputs. With one, it takes the phi's place; with several, one read per handle, and the result is chosen by comparing the phi's value with each handle at run time. Upstream removed such reads and wrote 0: 58,122 reads in FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE (2026-10-26, GitHub issue #168). See [Bindless reads whose handle phi also carries other values](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#bindless-reads-whose-handle-phi-also-carries-other-values). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitTexture.cs`, `EmitTex` (TLD 1D with integer coordinates only) and `EmitTexs` (TLDS `Texture1DLodZero`), with `IGpuAccessor.RecordTexelFetch1D`: Maxwell reads a 1D texture and a texture buffer with the same instruction, and the bound descriptor decides. When the texture type query does not answer "buffer", the read is translated as 2D at `(x & 0x3FFF, x >> 14)` instead of `(x, 0)`, and the handle is reported. A 1D texture (one row at most 16384 wide on the host) reads the same; the host binds a texture buffer in such a slot as a linear 2D texture of 16384-texel rows over its memory (`nvn_mtl.m` `tbuf_as_2d`). Upstream read `(x, 0)` and the host had only a dummy texture to give: the light and decal lists of Age of Calamity (at least 15,000 shaders) and Three Houses read zeros (2026-10-21). Marked `nxnative:` in the code.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/EmitterContext.cs` and `Translation/ShaderDefinitions.cs`: fixed-input compute lowering explicitly forwards passthrough positions and all captured generic attributes not replaced by the geometry shader, and inherits its output primitive from input topology. Independent offline stages have no next-stage usage mask, and Metal cannot provide the native NV passthrough raster stage. See [passthrough compute emission](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#passthrough-geometry-kernels-lose-raster-vertices) and [output bounds](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#passthrough-geometry-output-bounds-follow-input-topology).

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitSurface.cs`, `IntermediateRepresentation/TextureFlags.cs` and `CodeGen/Spirv/Instructions.cs`: the Metal path (`TranslationFlags.MetalImageAtomics`) bounds image atomics before forming the texel pointer, which SPIRV-Cross writes as a native texture atomic (MSL 3.1) on buffer, 2D, 2D-array and 3D images. Returning `IGN` atomics preserve the old texel on the valid edge and return zero outside the image; CAS is a native texture compare-exchange behind the same guard; predicate results and non-IGN modes remain rejected. See [bounds of image atomics](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#bounds-of-image-atomics) and [image atomics](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#image-atomics), found on SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI V: Vengeance's particle counters.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/StructuredIr/AstOptimizer.cs` (`Optimize`, `HasSideEffects`; PR #77 by Omnicrash): an assignment whose source has side effects (atomics, image atomics, calls) is neither propagated into its use (the use ran it a second time) nor removed when its value is unused (the atomic was lost). After nx2android `c6b211c` and `44eca7e` (MIT, below).

- The same file, `RemoveEmptyBlocks`, with `StructuredIr/StructuredProgram.cs` (passes the target language): no `if` inside a lone `else` is lifted to an else-if for SPIR-V, whose generator branches from an `If` only into an `Else` that follows it, so the else-if's branch became unreachable (PR #77; after nx2android `02e336f`).

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitTexture.cs` and `Instructions/InstEmitAmpereMem.cs` (TMML): the LOD is clamped at 0 and converted unsigned to 24.8, as the hardware returns it; a negative LOD read as a huge unsigned one (PR #77; the finding of yuzu #10234 and nx2android `44eca7e`, written anew here).

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/Translator.cs` (`EmitOpsAmpere`, `DeferAmpereWrites`) and `Instructions/InstEmitAmpereMem.cs` (LDG): a predicated variable-latency write whose predicate is false at issue writes nothing, so its deferred copy is guarded by the predicate as it was at issue; LDG reads its address before the predicate's branch (PR #77; upstream nxnative `9507c221`). The gather coordinate bias (`Transforms/TexturePass.cs`, Ryujinx's own) is enabled for the Android build through `QueryHostGatherBiasPrecision` = 8 (`dm/gfx/tools/vk_android_build.py` `GATHER_BIAS`).

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/Transforms/DrawParametersReplace.cs` (PR #83 by cr1stian): only c0 + 0x644 (the base instance) is replaced by the `BaseInstance` builtin, on hosts that ask for it (`QueryHasConstantBufferDrawParameters`, the Android jobs); the base vertex and the draw index stay in c0.

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Translation/TranslatorContext.cs`, `GetDepthRegister`: a pixel shader's depth output is read from register 4 x (render targets with any component enabled) + 1, the register after the next one past the colour outputs as `EmitterContext.PrepareForReturn` lays them out (four a target). Upstream counted enabled components, wrong for partial colour masks (agl's depth passes, `OmapTargets` 0x100 / 0x30 / 0x10f / 0x3f); the finding of Swap2-Native (MIT), written anew here ([docs/reference/shaders.md](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#a-pixel-shader-with-partial-colour-masks-wrote-the-wrong-depth)).

- `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitAmpereMem.cs`: ATOMG.CAS (0x3a9, `AAtomgCas`), the old value as its result; a multisample texture instruction's sample index goes before the texel offsets, where the SPIR-V generator reads it ([ATOMG.CAS and multisample fetches with offsets](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#atomgcas-and-multisample-fetches-with-offsets)).

- `StructuredIr/MeshShaderInfo.cs`, `CodeGen/Spirv/SpirvMeshEntry.cs`, `IGpuAccessor.cs` (`QueryMeshShaderTopology`) and `Spv.Generator/spirv.cs` (the `PrimitivePointIndicesEXT`, `PrimitiveLineIndicesEXT` and `CullPrimitiveEXT` builtins): mesh programs that output points, with their point size ([Point mesh programs had no mesh layout](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#point-mesh-programs-had-no-mesh-layout)). Both after findings of Swap2-Native (MIT), written anew.

nx2android (https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android, by Tung Pham) is MIT-licensed, as nxnative it is based on (its `README.md`, `nxnative/LICENSE`).

The shader translation tool in `dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate` references them to translate the original Switch shaders to SPIR-V.
- Switch 2 (NVN2) task and mesh programs (`TranslationFlags.TaskShader` / `MeshShader`, job stages `ts` / `ms`): `Instructions/InstEmitAmpereMesh.cs` (opcodes 0x923 / 0x927, the stage memories), `StructuredIr/MeshShaderInfo.cs`, `CodeGen/Spirv/SpirvMeshEntry.cs` (the TaskEXT / MeshEXT entry point, SPV_EXT_mesh_shader) and the mesh hunks of `IGpuAccessor.cs`, `ShaderProperties.cs`, `Translator.cs`, `TranslatorContext.cs`, `CodeGenContext.cs`, `Declarations.cs`, `Instructions.cs`, `SpirvGenerator.cs` and `Spv.Generator` (`spirv.cs`, `CoreGrammar.cs`, `Module.cs`). After [switch2mac](https://github.com/azmasm/switch2mac) (azmasm): its Ryujinx mesh changes are MIT; its decoding of 0x923 / 0x927 (`nx2_lower`, from [Eglantine](https://github.com/djihads80/eglantine)) is GPL-3.0-or-later, and so is `InstEmitAmpereMesh.cs`, which ports it (see below). See [NVN2 task and mesh programs filed under their SPH's stage](../../../docs/reference/shaders.md#nvn2-task-and-mesh-programs-filed-under-their-sphs-stage).

License: MIT, see `LICENSE.txt`, except `src/Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader/Instructions/InstEmitAmpereMesh.cs`, which is GPL-3.0-or-later (its SPDX header; full text in [COPYING.GPL-3.0](COPYING.GPL-3.0)). `Ryujinx.Graphics.Shader.dll`, the translator `dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_xlate_bin` and the Android `libdmsh_xlate.so` are built with that file, so each of them is a combined work distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later as a whole; every other file keeps its MIT license and notice on its own. Upstream: <https://github.com/Ryubing>.
